## Problem
What's slow / heavy, and where it hurts (endpoint, query, batch job).

## Measurement
Current numbers: latency, throughput, memory, cost. How measured.

## Hypothesis / approach
What you think the bottleneck is and how to fix it.

## Target
Concrete goal (e.g. p95 < 200 ms, memory < 1 GB).

## Checklist
- [ ] Benchmark before
- [ ] Change made
- [ ] Benchmark after, numbers posted in this issue
- [ ] No behavior regression
